coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City-local property and cadastral-map query services as described by official city sources or explicitly attributed city-center reports.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: City-specific registry map/service evidence was found, but no anonymous full parcel polygon was verified.

registryBasis: Yinchuan city government reports the municipal registration center launched cadastral-map visualization for property-information queries; the center is officially responsible for municipal real-estate registration. The live viewer shell is official and labeled 地籍图可视化.
technicalBlocker: Viewer query bootstrap uses /user/gettoken and then sends an Authorization token to GIS query endpoints. No token or gated query was requested; anonymous GET initialization returned HTTP 400.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the public map query returns full cadastral parcel polygons or only property/building lookup geometry; no authorized query was attempted.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
nextStep: Use only an approved public unauthenticated route if the city publishes one; do not call token bootstrap or GIS query routes under the current no-token scope.
